name: Half-Life
description: Single-line prompt with no glyphs at all — the fallback for a terminal with no Nerd Font installed.

name: Lambda
description: Minimal single-line prompt: a coloured glyph, the path and the git branch.

name: Spaceship
description: Two-line prompt with path and git on the left, exit status and time on the right.

name: Avit
description: Two-line prompt: user, path and git on the first line, a prompt glyph on the second.

name: Di4am0nd
description: Busy three-block prompt with a diamond-cut segment for every piece of context.

name: Bubblesline
description: Powerline prompt with ten segments across two lines — the most glyph-heavy bundled layout.
